## Experience

- Senior Associate Consultant · AI Engineer, CES Limited (Jul 2024 – present): 8+ enterprise AI agents with LangGraph, Microsoft Copilot Studio and Oracle AI Agent Studio (~60% less manual effort in finance and procurement); multi-agent pipelines with LangChain and CrewAI; N8n workflows into Oracle Fusion ERP; an evals framework of 200+ cases (+35% reliability); 5+ FastAPI microservices; RAG on Azure AI Foundry and AI Search over 10K+ documents; 15+ Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP integrations via OIC; 30+ BI Publisher reports migrated from EBS to Fusion Cloud.

## Projects

- Samvaad: AI voice agents that place outbound calls, hold a natural conversation and write what was agreed to calendar and records. https://frontend-nu-blond-93.vercel.app
- Cartesian Suite (Karta and Fusion Studio): a voice-first desktop agent for Hindi, Telugu and English with a policy engine and kill switch; and end-to-end Oracle Fusion implementation agents. https://cartesian-suite.vercel.app
- Multi-Agent Finance Automation Platform (LangGraph, CrewAI, FastAPI, Oracle Fusion Receivables): -70% manual processing time.
- Ask Badger, an enterprise RAG assistant (Azure AI Search, LangGraph): 88% answer accuracy, nightly LLM-as-judge evals.
- AI Vendor Onboarding Agent (N8n, Copilot Studio, LangChain): onboarding from 5 days to same-day for 200+ vendors a month.
- Oracle Fusion Copilot Agents, a suite of 8 (Copilot Studio, FastAPI on Azure).
- AI Evals & Agent Testing Framework: 500+ cases, LLM-as-judge rubrics, CI regression runs.
